defaultDesc:
Select which sound plays when you hit a note.
The list comes from data/hitsoundList.txt, so you can add your own
by appending a name to that txt and putting the sound file in sounds/hitsounds/.
Funny notes does "Tick!" when you hit them.
What song do you prefer for the Pause Screen?

Decode Ogg Vorbis and MP3 music while it plays instead of decoding the whole track up front.
Saves a lot of memory (a 2 MB song no longer keeps ~20 MB of PCM resident); sound, timing and seeking are unchanged.
Applies the next time a song or menu track is loaded. WAV / M4A always use the full decode.
